short_description: The European Commission is the politically independent executive branch of the European Union, headquartered in Brussels with additional departments in Luxembourg. Established on 16 January 1958 as the Commission of the European Economic Community, it proposes EU legislation, implements decisions of the European Parliament and the Council of the EU, and administers major programmes and regulations of direct relevance to the European startup and technology ecosystem, including Horizon Europe, the European Innovation Council, the Digital Markets Act, the Digital Services Act and the AI Act.
